items.item: The page has a breadcrumb or back link to the leave list, a title such as "New leave request", and a single-column form with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Nghỉ phép / Tạo đơn nghỉ phép'; h1 'Tạo đơn nghỉ phép'; label() helper renders a <label for> above each field; placeholders (reason, contact) always have a label. Sections stack in one column; only the date/duration trio sits in one row.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional ones (such as the attachment) are labelled as optional
items.evidence: '* Bắt buộc' legend plus a ' *' on Loại nghỉ, Từ ngày, Đến ngày, Lý do, Người duyệt; contact helper says 'Không bắt buộc'; attachment shows 'Đính kèm nếu có giấy tờ liên quan' and gets '*' only when needsDoc(). The attachment is only implicitly optional, with no literal 'optional' tag.

items.item: Leave type, start date, end date, approver and reason are present; the approver defaults to the employee's manager and can be changed
items.evidence: S.v.approver: 1 (Trần Minh Quân, manager:true, '· Quản lý trực tiếp'); the #approver combobox opens a searchable listbox ([data-pick]) and there is a 'Xóa' button; helper text 'Mặc định là quản lý trực tiếp của bạn.'

items.item: Start and end dates each allow a full day, morning half or afternoon half, and a single-day request can be set as a half day
items.evidence: There is one shared 'Thời lượng' select (#part: Cả ngày / Buổi sáng / Buổi chiều), enabled only when from===to. The start and end dates have no separate half-day choice, so a multi-day request cannot start at midday or end in the morning. Single-day half day works (workingDays returns 0.5).

items.item: The remaining leave balance for the chosen type is visible beside the form and updates with the selection, and the requested duration in days (such as 1.5) is calculated and shown live
items.evidence: Under the #type select: 'Còn 8,5 ngày' updates with the type; the role=status aria-live box shows '<n> ngày làm việc' and 'Còn lại sau khi nghỉ: x / y ngày', recalculated on every input via workingDays(). It is inline under the select rather than in a side panel, and some types (sick, unpaid) have no balance.

items.item: A request that exceeds the balance, or has an end date before the start date, shows an inline error tied to the field with `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`, and the entered input is kept
items.evidence:
check('to') returns 'Vượt quá số ngày còn lại…' or 'Chọn ngày bằng hoặc sau ngày bắt đầu…'; inv('to') emits aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="to-err" with

; state S.v is kept across re-render.

items.item: The attachment control states accepted file types and size limit, lists the chosen file with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: 'PDF, JPG, PNG hoặc DOCX, tối đa 5 MB mỗi tệp.'; file table with name/type/size and a 'Xóa' button (data-rm, aria-label 'Xóa <name>'); native input#files (sr-only) inside a label button, so keyboard focus and activation work; addFiles() rejects bad type or size with inline messages.

items.item: The submit action is a verb label ("Submit request") with a secondary Cancel, shows a busy state while submitting to prevent a double submit, and confirms success with a status message that is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: Sticky bar: 'Hủy' (btn-secondary) + 'Gửi đơn' (btn-primary); S.submitting renders the button disabled with a spinner and the submit handler returns early if S.submitting; success calls toast() into #toast role=status aria-live=polite and shows a 'Đơn … đã được gửi' view.

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning, and an option to save as draft is offered
items.evidence: The beforeunload handler and the guard() alertdialog ('Bạn có thay đổi chưa lưu. Rời trang mà không lưu?', Rời trang / Ở lại) cover the warning, but there is no 'Lưu nháp' or any save-as-draft control anywhere in the markup or script.

notes: Audit score 96; its only violation (table-above-fold) comes from a 'recent requests' table placed inside the form on a form page. Fails: no separate half-day choice for start and end dates (one shared 'Thời lượng' select), and no save-as-draft. The balance appears as inline text under the leave type, not in a beside-the-form panel. The skeleton uses a linear-gradient shimmer, only while loading, so it is not counted as a gradient tell. No greeting header, KPI tiles, glass, emoji, tracked uppercase, promo card or decorative chart. Status pills are tonal and few. The sidebar is white, not navy. Form sections are single-level cards, with no nested cards.
